svg.title: clawock data flow — sources, fetch fallback, portfolio and risk, three cadences, agent, postflight, data plane and delivery
svg.desc: Eight information layers feed ordered fetch-fallback routes (HK quotes Tencent plus Eastmoney HK then stooq then yfinance; US quotes Nasdaq, Eastmoney, Finnhub, Yahoo, yfinance, Alpha Vantage, Polygon; USDHKD Frankfurter, exchangerate.host, Yahoo; every live Eastmoney call through one throttled gateway; an empty fetch keeps the prior value). Python reconciles the book, runs the integrity gate and builds risk. Each cadence - the pre-open brief, session reports and intraday check-ins - runs a preflight that assembles only the blocks it can use; the agent reads those files and never fetches; a Python postflight validates and publishes to master, to the data-plane branch the dashboard polls, and to WeChat and Telegram. An LLM-free crontab watchdog checks every slot and mirrors to Telegram when the send is not confirmed.

text.tspan: Tencent · Nasdaq · Eastmoney · SEC EDGAR · HKEXnews · Finnhub · …
one throttled gateway, every live call
keeps the prior value — never a blank
HK + US totals sum only through it
· only the blocks this run can use
reads the context files, never fetches
